cover.caption: Derfra var det en halvtime å gå, i motvind.
cover.alt: Gutten går ut langs et værhardt nes i sterk motvind. Ytterst står et lavt, grått hus surret fast med stålvaiere, og på trappa står Nordavinden med jakka blafrende som et seil.
cover.prompt: A narrow road runs out along a bare, windswept headland to a low grey house lashed to the rock with steel cables, at the very edge of a white-capped grey sea. The Boy walks out along it, leaning hard into a northerly gale, his scarf and tufty hair blown straight back. On the steps of the house far ahead stands the North Wind, his huge hooded jacket flapping like a sail and fraying into cloud.

Picture: A narrow road runs out along a bare, windswept headland to a low grey house lashed to the rock with steel cables, at the very edge of a white-capped grey sea. The Boy walks out along it, leaning hard into a northerly gale, his scarf and tufty hair blown straight back. On the steps of the house far ahead stands the North Wind, his huge hooded jacket flapping like a sail and fraying into cloud.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):

He wears a cheap navy windbreaker zipped to the chin over a grey knitted jumper several sizes too big, baggy charcoal tracksuit bottoms, muddy canvas sneakers, a long brown knitted scarf and a battered dark-green backpack.

Story world: Present-day Norway in raw late autumn. The boy and his mother live in a small flat in a grey block of flats with open-air galleries along each floor, a storage shed at the end of the gallery, and a courtyard and car park between the blocks. A long bus ride north ends at a lonely road junction with a roadside motel and café, its red and blue neon glowing in the wet dark, rubbish containers at the back and a small goat pen behind the car park. From the last bus stop a road runs half an hour out onto a bare headland above the sea, to the North Wind's low grey house, lashed to the rock with steel cables. The oat flour comes in plastic bags. The magic cloth is a plain square white tablecloth. The stick is an old wooden walking stick with a curved handle.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: En sta og rettferdig tenåring som nekter å godta at de fattige skal miste det lille de har, og som tør å konfrontere både naturkrefter og mennesker som utnytter andre.
characters.look: A small, slight boy of about fourteen with a narrow, pale face, cheeks rosy from the cold, big ears that stick out, bright blue eyes, a determined frown and white-blond hair standing up in tufts. He wears a cheap navy windbreaker zipped to the chin over a grey knitted jumper several sizes too big, baggy charcoal tracksuit bottoms, muddy canvas sneakers, a long brown knitted scarf and a battered dark-green backpack.

characters.name: Moren
characters.description: En utslitt, skrøpelig alenemor i en liten leilighet som bare ønsker ro og mat på bordet, og som blir guttens moralske anker.
characters.look: A thin, worn-out woman of about sixty, a little stooped from her aching hips, with a long, gentle, deeply lined face, tired grey eyes, a thin mouth and one eyebrow often raised in doubt. Her grey hair hangs in one thin braid over her shoulder. She wears a faded plum-coloured fleece top, a darned brown knitted cardigan, grey tracksuit trousers and felt slippers.

characters.name: Nordavinden
characters.description: En barsk, nesten menneskelig vindskikkelse som virker like gammel som været selv—knapp i replikkene, men i stand til å gi gaver som kan endre liv.
characters.look: A very tall, gaunt old man, head and shoulders taller than anyone else, with a broad, weathered face, round puffed-out cheeks, icy-blue eyes, great bushy white eyebrows, a moustache like drifted snow and a long, frosty white beard that always streams sideways. He wears a huge storm-grey hooded anorak with the hood up, flapping like a sail, whose hem and sleeves fray into swirling grey cloud and snowflakes, so that nobody can tell where the jacket ends and the weather begins.

characters.name: Motellverten
characters.description: En grådig og opportunistisk motelleier som ser magi som en forretningsmulighet, og som ikke nøler med å stjele for å få en evig fordel.
characters.look: A tall, gangly motel owner of about fifty with a long, narrow face, a much too wide, toothy smile, small, hard, glittering eyes, a long pointed chin, restless hands and oily black hair twisted into one big curl on his forehead. He wears a wine-red quilted vest over a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark jeans, a black belt bag heavy with coins and keys, and scuffed brown loafers.

characters.name: Bukken
characters.description: En helt vanlig bukk å se på, som gjør gullmynter når gutten sier «Min bukk, gjør penger».
characters.look: A small, sturdy billy goat about the size of a large dog, with a shaggy snow-white coat, a light-grey face with a little pointed grey beard, bright amber eyes with slot-shaped pupils, short, curved, ridged horns, a stubby tail and neat black hooves. Around his neck he wears a red leather collar hung with two small brass bells, with a length of blue nylon rope tied to it.

places.name: the Flat
places.look: A small, tidy flat in a grey block of flats: one room with a kitchen corner, a small square kitchen table with two chairs, a worn brown armchair with a crocheted blanket by the window, a narrow hallway with coat hooks by the front door, a window onto the open-air gallery and a few potted plants on the sill. Poor and worn, but cared for.

illustrations.anchor: Den kom rett nordfra, over parkeringsplassen.
illustrations.caption: Gutten ble stående med hånda ute i tom luft.
illustrations.alt: På svalgangen river vinden en pose havremel fra gutten. Melet står som en hvit sky ut over parkeringsplassen, og gutten står igjen med hånda ute i tom luft.

Setting:
- the Flat: A small, tidy flat in a grey block of flats: one room with a kitchen corner, a small square kitchen table with two chairs, a worn brown armchair with a crocheted blanket by the window, a narrow hallway with coat hooks by the front door, a window onto the open-air gallery and a few potted plants on the sill. Poor and worn, but cared for.

Story world: Present-day Norway in raw late autumn. The boy and his mother live in a small flat in a grey block of flats with open-air galleries along each floor, a storage shed at the end of the gallery, and a courtyard and car park between the blocks. A long bus ride north ends at a lonely road junction with a roadside motel and café, its red and blue neon glowing in the wet dark, rubbish containers at the back and a small goat pen behind the car park. From the last bus stop a road runs half an hour out onto a bare headland above the sea, to the North Wind's low grey house, lashed to the rock with steel cables. The oat flour comes in plastic bags. The magic cloth is a plain square white tablecloth. The stick is an old wooden walking stick with a curved handle.

This story's season, light and colours: Raw November: wet asphalt, gusts of sleet, heavy slate-grey skies, a white-capped grey sea off the headland and early, blue-black darkness. Indoors, warm yellow lamplight; at the motel, red and blue neon reflected in puddles. Accents: flour white, neon red, petrol blue and mustard.

Art style: Contemporary Scandinavian editorial illustration: flat, graphic shapes with subtle risograph grain and a little hand-drawn texture, clean confident lines and a limited palette of spot inks led by deep petrol blue, with fjord teal, lingonberry red, honey mustard, sage green, warm paper off-white and ink charcoal, like the pages of a risograph-printed book, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours, in the cool, clear Nordic light of today. Present-day Norway: fjord towns, suburbs, farms with tractors, cabins, ferries, roadside petrol stations, offices and flats, grey rain and bright snow, with people in modern clothes such as rain jackets, knitted sweaters, hoodies, suits and work wear. The magic of the tale appears plainly in this everyday world: trolls, talking animals and enchantments look real and slightly absurd, drawn in the same flat style. Every character has their own face, build, age, hair and clothes exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Dry humour, careful composition with one focal point and plenty of negative space. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

Rules:
